The Total Ownership Experience®
While the advantages of owning an Infiniti can be felt most intimately while sitting in the driver’s seat of one of Local Retailer
our vehicles, it is our goal to ensure that every aspect of ownership is a rewarding experience. The Infiniti Total
Ownership Experience is an unprecedented commitment to professionalism and customer service that is tailored to
you and your individual needs. You can recognize it the moment you enter an Infiniti dealership, and in the service
you’ll receive for years to come. And in special benefits like a complimentary Infiniti Service Loan Car1, when you
bring your Infiniti for scheduled service; Trip Interruption Benefits2, should something go wrong; and Roadside
Assistance2 that’s ready to help 24 hours a day. It’s all part of our philosophy that quality service is an indispensable
feature of a quality vehicle.
